# CLSTATE block tx logIndex sell token amount cost fee offers funds K T offersAtBlock rule
#   amount..funds the event's words (offers: tokens still offered after the trade; funds: the quote raised since the
#   launch); K (word 10), T (word 11) and offers (word 7) of _tokenInfos at the block's end (the trade is the token's
#   last of the block: offersAtBlock = offers); rule OK: funds = floor(K*1e18/T) - floor(K*1e18/(T + 8e26 - offers)),
#   i.e. the curve the sold tokens name raised exactly the reported funds.
